feature_definitions.anchor_count: Parsed anchor tags, including anchors with no href.
feature_definitions.anchor_cross_site_count: HTTP(S) anchors whose destination site group differs from the page.

feature_definitions.context_identitylike_control_count: User-entry controls with type=email or identity/email/username cues in labels/attributes.

feature_definitions.context_label_only_passwordlike_control_: Non-password-type controls with a password cue only in associated label/aria-labelledby text.
feature_definitions.context_normalized_password_cue_control_: Controls with a password cue recognized only after normalization/common substitutions; not proof of obfuscation.

feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_cross_site_form_cou: Password-cued forms with a resolved HTTP(S) action outside the page site group.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_form_count: Forms owning at least one password-cued control.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_get_form_count: Password-cued forms with missing/empty method or method=get.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_handler_form_count: Password-cued forms declaring onsubmit; presence is not observed execution.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_https_to_http_form_: Password-cued forms on HTTPS pages whose action resolves to HTTP.
feature_definitions.context_passwordlike_unowned_control_cou: Password-cued controls without a resolved form in this tolerant parser.

feature_definitions.credential_hint_input_count: Inputs with user/email/password/login/OTP hints in name/id/autocomplete; heuristic only.
